authority_note: This is CWI's verified view of a small number of playlists, built from our own scans. It is NOT a universal authority on playlist legitimacy. A playlist not listed here has no grade from us at all.
corrections: If a curator believes an entry is wrong, contact hp@cumulativeweb.com with evidence and we will re-scan and update. Corrections are logged, not hidden.
freshness_rule: A grade is FRESH only if its evidence was observed within the last 48 hours. Older grades are labeled STALE. Stale is honest; manufactured freshness is not.
